request.query:
Why the Editor for Messages logon page does not work?
We have Editor for Messages installed on a Windows server. Users are accessing the web UI from a terminal server session that has been replaced recently. Users cannot login anymore from the new environment.

The fails as follows : the Editor for Messages logon page loads but when the user wants to validate their user/password by clicking on the "login" button, nothing occurs.

source_lineage.excerpt:
TEMPORARY FIX

COMMENTS
 *  This problem occurs with multiple users and
   with more than one CATIA level installed on
   the same machine.
   It does not occur if any mix of the following
   CATIA levels are installed:
   .
   V5R16SP4
   V5R17GA
   .

28) Logoff and logon with eneral user ID AAA
   29) Launch cmd prompt
   30)  Change to the CATIA V5R14 bin folder
   31) Execute cnext /regserver
   32) Error occurs.
   33) Click the Start Windows button
   34) Execute the regedt32 command
   35) The Registry Editor appears
   36) Select lect HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT
   /.CATDrawing/CATIA.Drawing/ShellNew
   -> Error occurs.
   37) Check access
   -> No user IDs have access authorization
   38) Logoff and logon with a general user ID BBB
   39) Launch cmd prompt
   40) Change to the CATIA V5R14 bin folder
   41) Execute cnext /regserver
   42) The same error as for user AAA occurs
   43) Select Windows Startr button
   44) Execute regedt32
   45) The Registry Editor appears
   46) Select "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT
   /.CATDrawing/CATIA.Drawing/ShellNew
   -> Error occurs
   47) Check access
   -> No user IDs have access authorization
   .
   Additional Information :
   This problem was not observed on V5R14 or earlier
   CATIA releases.
   .
   On V5R15 and V5R16, this problem was observed
   and was
   reproducible under the following condition :
   - Multiple users use the same machine.
   - Multiple CATIA environment were installed in the
   same machine.
   .
   Expected Result :
   Access authorization should not modified by
   execution of "REGSERVER" on R15 and R16.
   (Behaviour should be the same with R14 and
   earlier CATIA release levels)
   .
The Single Logon feature of DAMO is enabled only when using a Single User DAMO installation. The Single Logon feature does not work with a multi-user install of DAMO.

4. Select the option "Single Logon Feature" and select "This feature and all subfeatures..."
5. Click "Next" and click "Install".
6. Create the MAPI profile as the Administrative user. It is this step that installs the necessary "Lotus Notes Single Logon" service using the rights of the Administrative user.

7. It is necessary to restart the computer for the installation to complete and the service to start.
8. Log on to Windows as the intended DAMO user and, if one is not already created, create a new MAPI profile.
9. Once Outlook has started, confirm that Single Logon is enabled within MS Outlook by selecting Tools > Options > Domino Preferences tab > User Security and confirming that the "Login using your operating system login" option is selected.

To resolve the issue, add the user id, that needs tacmd login access to SOAP server user access list. Please follow the below procedure to add the user id 


1. On the computer where the hub monitoring server is installed, start Manage Tivoli Monitoring Services:
a. Windows : Click Start → Programs → IBM Tivoli Monitoring → Manage Tivoli Monitoring Services.
b. Linux : Change directory to <itm_install_dir>/bin and enter: ./itmcmd manage
2. Open Manage Tivoli Monitoring Services.
3. Right-click Tivoli Enterprise Monitoring Server. 
4. Click Advanced → Configure SOAP Server Hubs.
5. Enter a valid user name in the "User name" field text box and select the required access and click "Add User" button. Repeat the step for all the users

[/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21569270&aid=1] [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21569270&aid=1]

6. After selecting ok button, select Yes to recycle the TEMS.

6. After selecting ok button, select Yes to recycle the TEMS.

[/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21569270&aid=2] 

 

7. If you want all the users to have the permission to login to tacmd process, delete the "Access" item from the above list
Resolving the error depends on the cause.
